title: koanophyllon paucicrenatum
intro: Koanophyllon paucicrenatum, commonly known as the 'few-toothed Koanophyllon', is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Koanophyllon paucicrenatum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential treatment for wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Koanophyllon paucicrenatum include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
